records.jp: 史緒、色んなことをするって言ってたけど……<CR>今は何をしているの？
records.en_original: Fumio, you said you'd try doing a few different things, so...what are you up to?
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio, you said you'd try doing a few different things, so... what are you up to?
records.en: Fumio, you said you'd try all kinds of things...<CR>What are you doing now?

records.jp: あ、白井さん。<CR>今はプログラミングをちょっとね
records.en_original: Ah, Shirai. I've just been a little programming.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Shirai. I've just been doing a little programming.
records.en: Oh, Shirai-san.<CR>I'm doing a little programming right now.

records.jp: プログラミングって……ＳＥの仕事だよね
records.en_original: Programming... Like a software engineer?
records.en_auxiliary: Programming? Like a software engineer?
records.en: Programming... That's the kind of work a systems engineer does, right?

records.jp: （デスマーチとかトリアージもそうだけど、<CR>史緒って結構お父さんの影響受けてるんだなあ……）
records.en_original: (Between the death marches and triage, Fumio's dad has really been an influence on her...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Between the death marches and triage, Fumio's dad has really been an influence on her.)
records.en: (Between death marches and triage,<CR>Fumio really has been influenced by her father...)

records.jp: これまでもおばあ様に隠れてやっていたんだけど、<CR>本格的に手を付けるとまた違う感覚だわ
records.en_original: I've always programmed, but I had to keep it a secret from my grandmother. It feels so different going all out, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always programmed, but I had to keep it a secret from my grandmother. It feels so different going all in, though.
records.en: I've done it before in secret from Grandmother,<CR>but tackling it seriously feels different.

records.jp: えっ、もうやってたんだ……
records.en_original: Huh, so you already have some experience...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, so you already have some experience.
records.en: Huh, so you already have some experience...

records.jp: それでね、白井さんにもちょっと見てほしいの。<CR>他の人がどう感じるか知りたいから
records.en_original: Anyway, I wanted you to take a look. I want to know what other people would think about this.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, I wanted you to take a look. I want to know what other people would think about this.
records.en: And I'd like you to take a look too, Shirai-san.<CR>I want to know how someone else feels about it.

records.jp: もちろんいいよ。<CR>何だか面白そうだし
records.en_original: Of course. It seems pretty interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. It seems pretty interesting.
records.en: Of course.<CR>It looks interesting.

records.jp: ありがとう！<CR>白井さんなら快く聞いてくれると思ってたわ
records.en_original: Thank you! <CR>Shirai's willing to try just about anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you! Shirai's willing to try just about anything.
records.en: Thank you!<CR>I knew you'd be happy to hear me out, Shirai-san.

records.jp: やっぱり持つべきものは友よね。きっと白井さんなら<CR>心から協力しようとしてくれてるはず！
records.en_original: It's so nice to have friends. I'm sure she'll offer me her wholehearted support, regardless of my code's quality.
records.en_auxiliary: It's so nice to have friends. I'm sure she'll offer me her wholehearted support, regardless of my code's quality.
records.en: It's great to have friends.<CR>I'm sure you're sincerely trying to help me, Shirai-san!

records.jp: 間違ってはないけど……口に出すのはやめようね？
records.en_original: You're not wrong, but... You don't have to say that aloud.
records.en_auxiliary: You're not wrong, but... You don't have to say that aloud.
records.en: You're not wrong, but... let's stop saying it out loud, okay?

records.jp: うーん……忙しいけど、まあいいかな。<CR>何か参考になるといいんだけど
records.en_original: Hmm... I'm pretty busy, but okay. I just hope I can help.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. I'm pretty busy, but okay. I just hope I can help.
records.en: Hmm... I'm busy, but I guess it's okay.<CR>I hope I can give you something useful.

records.jp: む、しぶしぶといった反応ね……でもいいわ、<CR>見てくれるってことは私の成長に繋がるもの
records.en_original: Hmm... A reluctant response. But oh well. Just having her looking things over will aid my growth.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh? A reluctant response. But oh well. Just having her looking things over will aid my growth.
records.en: Hm, that sounded reluctant... But that's all right.<CR>Having her look at it will help me grow.

records.jp: ここは素直に喜んでおくべきだよね、私！
records.en_original: I should express my happiness as honestly as possible!
records.en_auxiliary: I should express my happiness as honestly as possible!
records.en: I should just be happy about this, shouldn't I?

records.jp: ……だから、口に出てるってば……
records.en_original: ...You're saying what you're thinking again...
records.en_auxiliary: You're saying what you're thinking again...
records.en: ...You're saying what you're thinking again...

records.jp: ええと、それじゃあさっそく見てもらわなくちゃ……<CR>この学校、どこかにパソコンはないかしら？
records.en_original: Anyway, I want to show you right away... Is there a computer somewhere in this school?
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, I want to show you right away. Is there a computer somewhere in this school?
records.en: Now, I need to show it to you right away...<CR>Is there a computer somewhere in this school?

records.jp: パソコンか……脚本室にあるかも。<CR>ちょっと亜子に聞いてみよう
records.en_original: A computer... Maybe in the writing room? I'll try asking Ako.
records.en_auxiliary: A computer? Maybe in the writing room? I'll try asking Ako.
records.en: A computer... There might be one in the script room.<CR>Let's ask Ako.

records.jp: あれ？　白井ちゃんに多谷ちゃん！<CR>どうかしたの？
records.en_original: Huh? Shirai and Taya! To what do I owe this pleasure?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Shirai and Taya! To what do I owe this pleasure?
records.en: Huh? Shirai-chan and Taya-chan!<CR>What's up?

records.jp: 亜子、えっとね……パソコンがあったら貸してもらえない？<CR>史緒がやってるプログラミングをちょっと見せてもらいたくて
records.en_original: Ako, um... If you have a computer, could you lend it to us? Fumio wanted to show me the programming she's doing.
records.en_auxiliary: Ako, um... If you have a computer, could you lend it to us? Fumio wanted to show me the programming she's doing.
records.en: Ako, um... Could you lend us a computer if you have one?<CR>I want to see some of the programming Fumio has been doing.

records.jp: 多谷ちゃんがプログラミング！？　天才ピアニストが<CR>まさかのプログラマーに転向……これは大スクープ……！
records.en_original: Taya's doing programming!? To think the genius pianist has started tapping different keys! This is a huge scoop...!
records.en_auxiliary: Taya's doing programming?! To think the genius pianist has started tapping different keys! This is a huge scoop!
records.en: Taya-chan is programming!? The genius pianist<CR>makes an unexpected turn toward programming... This is a huge scoop...!

records.jp: ……えっと、一之瀬さん、<CR>目が輝きすぎてて何だか怖いかも……
records.en_original: ...Um, Ichinose, the fire in your eyes is a little scary...
records.en_auxiliary: ...Um, Ichinose, the fire in your eyes is a little scary.
records.en: ...Um, Ichinose-san,<CR>your eyes are sparkling so intensely it's a little scary...

records.jp: あはは……それで、どうかな？<CR>パソコン、貸してもらえそう？
records.en_original: Ahaha... Anyway, what do you say? Can you lend us a computer?
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Anyway, what do you say? Can you lend us a computer?
records.en: Ahaha... So, what do you think?<CR>Could you lend us a computer?

records.jp: もちろんだよ！　それで、その後でじっくりと<CR>始めたきっかけとかのインタビューを……っ
records.en_original: Of course! And afterwards, we'll have an interview, and you can tell me all about why you started...
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! And afterwards, we'll have an interview, and you can tell me all about why you started.
records.en: Of course! And afterward, I can interview you at length<CR>about what made you start—

records.jp: そ、その話はまた後で！
records.en_original: S-Save that for another day!
records.en_auxiliary: S-save that for another day!
records.en: S-Save that for another day!

records.jp: 隠れてやってたとは聞いたけど……<CR>こんな複雑なことまでできるなんてすごいね……
records.en_original: You said you were doing this in secret before... But it's amazing that you can do something so complicated...
records.en_auxiliary: You said you were doing this in secret before, but it's amazing that you can do something so complicated.
records.en: You said you'd done it in secret...<CR>It's amazing you can make something this complicated...

records.jp: 天才って、一つできると<CR>他のことも何でもできちゃうんだねえ……
records.en_original: I guess her genius isn't limited to a single field.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess her genius isn't limited to a single field.
records.en: So if a genius can do one thing,<CR>she can do anything else too...

records.jp: みんなが褒めてくれてる……ちょっといい気分かも？<CR>でも、ここは謙虚に、謙虚に……
records.en_original: Everyone's praising me... This is a good feeling. But I need to stay modest, just stay modest...
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone's praising me. This is a good feeling. But I need to stay modest, just stay modest...
records.en: Everyone's praising me... This feels rather nice.<CR>But I must stay humble. Humble...

records.jp: （うん、半分くらい台無し……）
records.en_original: (It doesn't help when you voice all your thoughts...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It doesn't help when you voice all your thoughts.)
records.en: (It doesn't help when you voice all your thoughts...)

records.jp: そ、それでどうかな？<CR>動かしてみて使いにくいところはない？
records.en_original: S-So, what do you think? Is there anything that feels difficult to use?
records.en_auxiliary: S-so, what do you think? Is there anything that feels difficult to use?
records.en: S-So, what do you think?<CR>Is anything difficult to use when you try it?

records.jp: ………。うーん、あえて言うなら、だけど……<CR>ここで間違えた時に戻れないのが少し不便……かな？
records.en_original: ...Hm, if I had to mention something... It's a little inconvenient that you can't go back if you mess up here...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm, if I had to nitpick something... It's a little inconvenient that you can't go back if you mess up here.
records.en: ...Hmm, if I had to name something...<CR>It's a little inconvenient that you can't go back after making a mistake here.

records.jp: その場所ね？　ちょっと貸して……<CR>ここを、こうして、もう一度……
records.en_original: Right there? Just a second... I'll do this here, and then...
records.en_auxiliary: Right there? Just a second! I'll do this here, and then...
records.en: That spot? Let me see...<CR>Change this here, then try it again...

records.jp: これでどうかしら？
records.en_original: How's this?
records.en_auxiliary: How's this?
records.en: How's this?

records.jp: あっ、すごい！　もう変わってる！
records.en_original: Wow, amazing! It's already changed!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, amazing! It's already changed!
records.en: Wow, amazing! It's already changed!

records.jp: うん、すごく使いやすくなったよ！
records.en_original: Yeah, it's really easy to use now!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, it's really easy to use now!
records.en: Yeah, it's really easy to use now!

records.jp: ふふ……良かったわ、いいものになって。<CR>……あ……っ
records.en_original: Hehe... I'm glad it turned out well... Ah...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe! I'm glad it turned out well. Ah...
records.en: Hehe... I'm glad it turned out well.<CR>...Ah...

records.jp: 史緒？
records.en_original: Fumio?
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio?
records.en: Fumio?

records.jp: この感覚……他の人が感じたことを聞いて<CR>より良くする感覚……これだわ！
records.en_original: This feeling... The sense of listening to the feelings of others and improving... This is it!
records.en_auxiliary: This feeling... The sense of listening to the feelings of others and improving. This is it!
records.en: This feeling... Listening to what someone else felt<CR>and making it better... This is it!

records.jp: ありがとう、白井さん、一之瀬さん！<CR>さっそくピアノを弾いてくる！
records.en_original: Thank you both! I need to go play the piano now!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you both! I need to go play the piano now!
records.en: Thank you, Shirai-san, Ichinose-san!<CR>I'm going to play the piano right away!

records.jp: え、多谷ちゃん！？<CR>インタビューは……！？
records.en_original: Wait, Taya!? What about the interview...!?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, Taya?! What about the interview?!
records.en: Wait, Taya-chan!?<CR>What about the interview...!?

records.jp: あはは……史緒は思いついたらすぐ動くから……<CR>インタビューはまた今度ってことかな……
records.en_original: Ahaha... Fumio goes where the wind takes her... You might have to save the interview for next time...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Fumio goes where the wind takes her. You might have to save the interview for next time.
records.en: Ahaha... Fumio acts as soon as she gets an idea...<CR>I guess the interview will have to wait until next time...

records.jp: うーん――
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...
